naveen: Heads-up: during a tenant demo we noticed the Console scope-expression editor and the API disagree on which roles match a compound scope.
zoe: can you give an example?
naveen: yes. In the editor I add scope expression `tenant:acme OR (org:partners AND env:staging)` and the UI preview lists role `PartnerStagingOps` but the API query `GET /api/v1/roles?scope_expr=tenant:acme%20OR%20(org:partners%20AND%20env:staging)` does not return it.
zoe: curious. Might be URL encoding or precedence parsing mismatch.
cory: quick test: I ran `curl -s 'https://console/api/v1/roles?scope_expr=tenant:acme+OR+%28org:partners+AND+env:staging%29'` and got back only tenant-scoped matches.
cory: snippet: ```json
{"items":[{"id":"r_900","name":"TenantAdmin","scope":"tenant:acme"}]}
```
andrea: that's bad. The editor uses an internal parser (scope-parser v2) that treats `OR` as low precedence and parentheses respected. The API was still using scope-parser v1 which treated `OR` as same precedence as `AND` in some edge cases. We introduced v2 in the UI as part of the scope-composer rollout.
zoe: so UI and API disagree because of different parser versions. Can we revert the UI? It's already live in the canary cohort.
aveen: customers in the canary noticed inconsistent search hits. We should either 1) downgrade UI until API matches, or 2) fast-path API to accept `scope_expr_v2=true` and run v2 parser for canary tenants.
cory: technical constraint: the DB-backed index stores normalized scope tokens from v1 schema. v2 adds `env` token normalization which the index lacks for older entries, causing some roles not to match even if parser logic aligns. So we have two problems: parser semantics and index normalization.
andrea: proposal: short-term -> enable v2 parsing on API for canary tenants but fallback to full table scan / read-through for hits that would be missed by index (flagged by `index_match=false`). Emit telemetry so we can quantify misses. Long-term -> backfill normalized tokens and reindex.
zoe: +1. We should surface an inline console notice for canary users: "Scope composer is experimental for your account; results may be incomplete. Use 'Ensure fresh' to re-run matching." Put behind `showScopeComposerCanaryNotice`.
aveen: also add telemetry events `scope_expr.match_index_hit` (bool), `scope_expr.parser_version` (v1/v2), and a counter `scope_expr.index_misses_per_tenant`. Important for deciding reindex priority.
cory: I'll implement the API patch: services/roles/matcher.go -> if tenant in canary && parser_version=req.v2 then try indexed match; if index returns empty, run fallback full-scan matcher but mark `index_match=false` in response meta. Also add a small rate limit on full-scan to avoid spikes.
andrea: I'll own the reindex plan: create a backfill job that streams roles and applies v2 tokenization to the index. We'll run in low priority and track `reindex.progress` and `reindex.mismatch_count`.
oaudit-bot: audit: scope-parser-change.requested_by=naveen, canary_cohort=[alpha,acme-beta], request_id=req_4812345
zoe: UI changes: show a pill in search results when `meta.index_match==false`: "Partial results - click to ensure fresh match". That button will call `GET /api/v1/roles?scope_expr=...&fresh=true` which hits full-scan matcher.
aveen: add a small QA plan: 1) run matrix of 50 random scope expressions across tenant `acme` and `acme-beta`; 2) compare UI preview vs API `?fresh=true` results; 3) measure `index_miss_rate`.
cory: deploying a canary branch to staging with index_fallback and telemetry now. PR will include unit tests for parser parity and integration test for fallback path. Tagging @andrea for reindex scheduling.
deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging (build #9120) - running tests.
andrea: thanks. After we get stable telemetry and low miss rate, we'll schedule reindexing and then flip parser v2 for everyone.
